content: आधिः {%m.%} [आधीयते स्थाप्यते प्रतीकाराय मनोऽनेन, आ-धा-कि <ls>P. III. 3. 92</ls>; connected with आध्यै in some senses] .²1 Mental pain or anguish, agony, anxiety (<ab>opp.</ab> व्याधि which is bodily pain); न तेषामापदः सन्ति नाधयो व्याधयस्तथा <ls>Mb.</ls>; मनोगतमाधिहेतुम् <ls>Ś. 3. 10</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 27</ls>, <ls n="R.">9. 54</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 105</ls>; <ls>Bv. 4. 11</ls>; <ls>Māl. 4</ls>; <ls>Ki. 1. 37</ls>. .²2 A bane, curse, misery; यान्त्येवं गृहिणीपदं युवतयो वामाः कुलस्याधयः <ls>Ś. 4. 18</ls>; <ls>Mv. 6. 28</ls>. .²3 A pledge, deposit, pawn, mortgage; <ls>Y. 2. 23</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 143</ls>; आधिश्चोपनिधिश्चोभौ न कालात्ययमर्हतः <ls n="Ms. 8.">145</ls>. .²4 A place, residence. .²5 Location, site. .²6 Definition, epithet, attribute, title. .²7 Misfortune, calamity (व्यसन). .²8 Reflection on religion or duty (धर्मचिन्ता) .²9 Hope, expectation. .²10 A man solicitous for the maintenance of his family (कुटुम्बव्यापृत). .²11 Punishment; एनमाधिं दापयिष्येद्यस्मात्तेन भयं क्वचित् <ls>Śukra. 4. 641</ls>.
